# Cricbuzz

> Live cricket scores, streaming, commentary, highlights, videos, news, schedules, rankings, and series coverage for fans in the USA, Canada, and worldwide.

Cricbuzz is a cricket platform covering international and domestic matches with live scorecards, ball-by-ball commentary, fixtures, points tables, editorial analysis, player and team data, rankings, and video content. It also offers Cricbuzz Plus subscriptions and live streaming access in supported regions.

## Live Scores & Match Center
- [Live Scores Home](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-match/live-scores): Real-time live scores, commentary, scorecards, and match status across ongoing games.
- [Live Cricket Scorecard](https://www.cricbuzz.com/live-cricket-scorecard): Ball-by-ball scorecards and innings breakdowns for live and recent matches.
- [Live Full Commentary](https://www.cricbuzz.com/live-cricket-full-commentary): Detailed over-by-over commentary and match narrative for live games.
- [Live Match Results](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-match/live-scores): Access current matches alongside recent results and status updates.
- [Upcoming Matches](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-schedule/upcoming-series): Browse upcoming fixtures, tours, and tournament schedules.

## Schedules, Series & Tournaments
- [Cricket Schedule](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-schedule): Full cricket calendar with international and domestic fixtures.
- [Upcoming Series](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-schedule/upcoming-series): List of upcoming bilateral series and tournaments.
- [Current Series](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-series): Ongoing series and tournaments with standings and match links.
- [Indian Premier League](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-series/9237/indian-premier-league-2025): Dedicated IPL series hub with fixtures, squads, and results.
- [ICC Champions Trophy 2025](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-series/9327/icc-champions-trophy-2025): Tournament page with schedule, points table, and match coverage.
- [World Test Championship](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-series/9025/world-test-championship-2023-25): Long-form championship coverage with standings and fixtures.

## News & Editorial
- [Cricket News](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news): Latest cricket news, reports, previews, and breaking developments.
- [Editorials](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/editorial-list): Opinion pieces, analysis, and feature writing from Cricbuzz editors.
- [Match Previews](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/latest-news): Pre-match stories, team updates, and context around upcoming fixtures.
- [Latest News](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/latest-news): Chronological feed of recent cricket stories and updates.
- [News Archive](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/archives): Archived cricket news organized by date and publication history.

## Rankings, Stats & Records
- [ICC Rankings - Men](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-stats/icc-rankings/men): Official men’s team, batting, bowling, and all-rounder rankings.
- [ICC Rankings - Women](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-stats/icc-rankings/women): Official women’s team and player rankings across formats.
- [Cricket Stats Home](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-stats): Entry point for rankings, records, and statistical resources.
- [Player Search](https://www.cricbuzz.com/profiles): Search player profiles, career stats, and recent form.
- [Records](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-stats/records): Historical cricket records across formats, teams, and players.
- [Points Table](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-series/points-table): Tournament standings and qualification tables for active competitions.

## Teams & Players
- [Player Profiles](https://www.cricbuzz.com/profiles): Directory of cricketers with career summaries and statistics.
- [Teams Directory](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-team): Browse international and domestic cricket team pages.
- [India Team](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-team/india/2): India team page with squad, fixtures, and recent results.
- [Australia Team](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-team/australia/4): Australia team page with squad details and match links.
- [England Team](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-team/england/9): England team page with players, schedule, and results.
- [Virat Kohli Profile](https://www.cricbuzz.com/profiles/1413/virat-kohli): Player profile with batting records, career stats, and biography.
- [Rohit Sharma Profile](https://www.cricbuzz.com/profiles/576/rohit-sharma): Player page with format-wise numbers and recent performances.

## Photos, Videos & Highlights
- [Cricket Videos](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-videos): Video hub for interviews, analysis, and match-related clips.
- [Highlights](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-videos/highlights): Match highlights and key moments from recent games.
- [Press Conference Videos](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-videos/press-conference): Media interactions and post-match press conference clips.
- [Cricket Photos](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-gallery/photos): Photo galleries from matches, training, and events.
- [Top Stories Videos](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-videos/latest-videos): Latest video uploads covering news and analysis.

## Series Coverage & Competition Hubs

- [The Hundred](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-series/9129/the-hundred-mens-competition-2024): Competition hub for The Hundred men’s tournament.
- [Ranji Trophy](https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-series/9108/ranji-trophy-2024-25): Domestic first-class tournament page with fixtures and results.
